route_text: Diamond OA: no author fees, so no agreement is needed.

Taylor & Francis Jisc agreement 2026-28 covers OA in hybrid (Open Select) journals for UofG corresponding authors. No funder condition stated. Covers research and review articles and some other types (e.g. methods, case reports, opinion); confirm for your article type.
Taylor & Francis Jisc agreement 2026-28 covers T&F fully OA journals. This title is not named on the UofG page, so confirm it is included.
Wiley Jisc agreement 2026-28: OA in hybrid journals is unlimited for UofG corresponding authors (primary research and review articles). Not affected by the fully OA funding cap.

category: Covered while Wiley national fund lasts
route_text: Wiley fully OA titles are paid from a finite national Jisc fund, first come first served. UofG projects the cap will be reached on 4 November 2026; coverage needs institutional approval, editorial acceptance and licence signing all completed before the cap. Articles completed in 2027 may be considered against the 2027 allocation, subject to availability. After the cap, papers acknowledging UKRI, Wellcome or BHF funding may still be eligible for UofG OA grants; unfunded papers have no UofG route.
Sage Jisc agreement 2026-28 covers OA in subscription journals in the Sage Premier, IMechE and RSM collections (research, review, case reports). Confirm this title is on the Sage Premier 2026 list.
Elsevier Jisc agreement 2026-28 covers OA in subscription journals regardless of funding source (research and review articles). Confirm the title is on Elsevier's Jisc eligible list.

category: Discount only: you pay the rest
route_text: Elsevier fully OA journal: UofG authors get 15% off the APC; the author pays the remaining 85%. No central UofG fund for unfunded papers.
Springer Nature Jisc agreement 2026-28: unlimited OA in hybrid journals for UofG corresponding authors with a paid contract or student registration at submission.

category: Discount only: you pay the rest
route_text: Springer Nature/BMC fully OA: 15% APC discount for UofG corresponding authors 2026-28. The full APC can be met from central funds only for papers acknowledging UKRI, Wellcome or BHF awards.
